names: UCSF Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision
record.summary: UCSF's Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision, a 347,500-sq-ft, 12-story eye-care tower (with a 5-story south wing and a garden-topped 3-story north wing) at 490 Illinois Street in Mission Bay, opened November 2020 at a reported construction cost of about $237 million; designed by SmithGroup, with fundraising led by the nonprofit That Man May See.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed DataSF Building Footprints outline (mblr SF3940003), name/address from OpenStreetMap way 84821715 (490 Illinois St); not a hand trace or plan estimate. This building's DataSF footprint shares its mblr (SF3940003) with the adjacent 499 Illinois St building (below) -- both address points fall on the same Assessor block-lot pairing in the source data, consistent with the two being described as a connected campus (409-499 Illinois) in commercial listings, but the two footprints themselves are geometrically distinct pieces, used here as separate records since they carry separate names, addresses, and OSM tags.
